params.name: a
params.choice: [v for v in range(-9, 10) if v != 0]

params.name: b
params.choice: [v for v in range(-9, 10) if v != 0]

params.name: qn
params.let: "first" if (cx > 0 and cy > 0) else ("second" if (cx < 0 and cy > 0) else ("third" if (cx < 0 and cy < 0) else "fourth"))

stem: The point $B$ is the symmetric of $A({=a}, {=b})$ with respect to the {=n1}, and $C$ is the symmetric of $B$ with respect to the {=n2}. Find the coordinates of $C$.
solution: Reflection in the x-axis gives $(x, -y)$; in the y-axis gives $(-x, y)$; in the origin gives $(-x, -y)$.
$B$, the symmetric of $A({=a}, {=b})$ with respect to the {=n1}, is $({=bx}, {=by})$.
$C$, the symmetric of $B$ with respect to the {=n2}, is $({=cx}, {=cy})$.
Since $x = {=cx}$ and $y = {=cy}$, $C$ lies in the {=qn} quadrant.
notes: Two successive reflections with different mappings; nonzero coordinates.
